import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    w = p[9]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*v + p[2]*v**2 + p[3]*x + p[4]*np.tanh(v)
            + (p[5] + p[6]*v)*C + (p[7] + p[8]*v)*S)
